{{Top|leg}}
A '''Rebel Alliance cell''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chabosh]] overthrew the local [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in an uprising around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] but was later [[Battle of Chabosh (Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Harsh]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Cauldron]]''.
